SID_STAT_TOOL_TIP_ATTACK: The range of possible damage dealt by a basic attack with the currently equipped weapon. The lower damage range can be increased through Mastery.
SID_STAT_TOOL_TIP_STR: The main stat for Warriors. Increases damage dealt by Warriors, and slightly increases damage dealt by Archers and Thieves. Also increases Weapon Def.
SID_STAT_TOOL_TIP_DEX: The main stat for Archers. Increases damage dealt by Archers, and slightly increases damage dealt by Warriors and Thieves. Also increases Accuracy for non-Magician classes.
SID_STAT_TOOL_TIP_INT: The main stat for Magicians. Slightly increases damage dealt and Accuracy for Magicians. Also increases Magic, and slightly increases Magic Def.
SID_STAT_TOOL_TIP_LUK: The main stat for Thieves. Increases damage dealt by Thieves. Also increases Evasion, slightly increases Accuracy, and reduces EXP lost on death.
SID_STAT_TOOL_TIP_WEP_DEF: Reduces damage taken from physical attacks.
SID_STAT_TOOL_TIP_MAGIC: Determines the damage dealt by magic attacks.
SID_STAT_TOOL_TIP_MAGIC_DEF: Reduces damage taken from magic attacks.
SID_STAT_TOOL_TIP_ACC: Determines how often your attacks hit monsters. More Accuracy is required to successfully hit monsters with higher Evasion.
SID_STAT_TOOL_TIP_EVA: Determines how often you evade physical attacks from monsters. More Evasion is required to successfully evade attacks from monsters with higher Accuracy.
SID_STAT_TOOL_TIP_CRIT_RATE: Determines how often your attacks critically hit. Critical hits deal more damage based on Crit. Damage.
SID_STAT_TOOL_TIP_CRIT_DAM: Determines the increased damage dealt by critical hits.
SID_STAT_TOOL_TIP_SPEED: Determines how quickly your character moves.
SID_STAT_TOOL_TIP_JUMP: Determines how high your character jumps.
